# Libraries

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(haven)
library(foreign)
library(writexl)

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)

library(table1)
library(naniar)
library(corrr)
library(corrplot)


library(lavaan)
library(semTools)

library(effsize)
library(confintr)
```


# Auxiliary

`compare_incl`, to compare included and excluded participants and `compare_vars` to do multiple at one time

```{r}
compare_incl = function(x, g) {
  g = factor(g)
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    tibble(test = "t.test", stat = unname(t.test(x ~ g)$statistic),
                            p = t.test(x ~ g)$p.value,
           effect = "Cohen's d", size = cohen.d(x ~ g)$estimate) }
  else {ch = chisq.test(table(droplevels(factor(x)), g))
  tibble(test = "Chi-squared", stat = unname(ch$statistic),
                               p = ch$p.value,
         effect = "Cramer's V", size = cramersv(ch)) } }

compare_vars = \(data, vars, group) {
  bind_rows(sapply(vars, \(v) compare_incl(data[[v]], data[[group]]),
                   simplify = FALSE), .id = "variable") }
```

`fit_diff`, to compare fit indices

```{r}
fit_diff <- function(fit1, fit2) {
  lrt <- lavTestLRT(fit1, fit2)
  data.frame(D.chisq = round(lrt$`Chisq diff`[2], 2),
             D.df = lrt$`Df diff`[2],
             pvalue = signif(lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2], 3),
             D.cfi = round(unname(fitMeasures(fit2, "cfi.scaled") -
                                   fitMeasures(fit1, "cfi.scaled")), 3),
             D.rmsea = round(unname(fitMeasures(fit2, "rmsea.scaled") -
                                     fitMeasures(fit1, "rmsea.scaled")), 3))}
```

Vectors with fit indices' names

```{r}
names_fit = c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "cfi.scaled",
              "rmsea.scaled", "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled",
              "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")

names_short = c("chisq", "df", "chisq/df", "cfi", "rmsea",
                "ci.lower", "ci.upper", "srmr")
```

# I. Data preparation

## 1. Data selection

Import the data

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
d0 = read.spss("TBIMS_cleaned2.sav", use.value.labels = T, to.data.frame = T)
```

Select the sociodemographic and test variables

```{r}
swls0 = d0 %>%
  select(c("UID", "Age", "Race", "Sex", "Mar", "EduYears",
           "Cause", "CTComp", "GCSTot",
           names(d0)[grepl("^FUYear", names(d0))],
           names(d0)[grepl("^SWLS", names(d0))]))
```

Remove "SWLSTOT", as it's not a raw item

```{r}
swls0 = swls0 %>%
  select(-names(d0)[grepl("SWLSTOT", names(d0))])
```

Recode items into (1) Strongly disagree, (2) Disagree, (3) Slightly disagree, (4) Neither agree nor disagree, (5) Slightly agree, (6) Agree, (7) Strongly agree, and NA (any other number, and NA)

```{r}
swls0 <- swls0 %>%
  mutate(across(
    matches("SWLS"),
    ~ factor(.x, ordered = TRUE,
             levels = c("Strongly Disagree", "Disagree", "Slightly Disagree",
                        "Neither Agree nor Disagree", "Slightly Agree",
                        "Agree", "Strongly Agree"))))
```

## 2. Group selection

Create columns for missing data

```{r}
swls0 <- swls0 %>%
  mutate(
    missing_T1 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".1"), is.na)),
    missing_T2 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".2"), is.na)),
    missing_T3 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".3"), is.na)),
    missing_T4 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".4"), is.na)),
    missing_T5 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".5"), is.na)),
    missing_T6 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".6"), is.na)),
    missing_T7 = rowSums(across(contains("SWLS") & ends_with(".7"), is.na)) )
```

Check missing data

```{r}
swls0 %>%
  select(starts_with("missing_T")) %>%
  sapply(\(x) table(cut(x, c(-Inf, 0, 4, 5),
                        labels = c("0", "1-4", "5")), useNA = "always"))
```

**Cross-sectional**

Check number of complete data for each timepoint (divided by race)

```{r}
swls0 %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_2 = sum(missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_3 = sum(missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_4 = sum(missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_5 = sum(missing_T5 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_6 = sum(missing_T6 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_7 = sum(missing_T7 == 0, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

::: {style="background-color:#fff3cd;             border-left:6px solid #ffcc00;             padding:12px;             margin:10px 0;"}
**Available cross-sectional data:**

- White, Black and Hispanic patients
- Timepoints 1, 2, 3 and 4
- Lowest n=208
:::

**Longitudinal**

Check number of complete data for each race (divided by T1, T1+T2...)

```{r}
swls0 %>%
  group_by(Race) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    timepoint_1 = sum(missing_T1 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2_3 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0 & missing_T3 == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    timepoint_1_2_3_4 = sum(missing_T1 == 0 & missing_T2 == 0 & missing_T3 == 0 & missing_T4 == 0, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
```

::: {style="background-color:#fff3cd;             border-left:6px solid #ffcc00;             padding:12px;             margin:10px 0;"}
**Available longitudinal data:**

- White, Black and Hispanic patients
- Timepoints 1, 2 and 3
- Lowest n=253
:::


## 3. Final dataset

**Selected data**

```{r}
swls = swls0[swls0$Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
                 c(1:9, # sociodemographic
                   which(grepl("\\.(1|2|3)$", names(swls0))) )]
swls$Race <- droplevels(swls$Race)
```

**Proportions per timepoint**

```{r}
proportions = swls %>%
  select(matches("^SWLS.+\\.(1|2|3)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("item", "timepoint"),
               names_sep = "\\.", values_to = "response") %>%
  drop_na(response) %>%
  count(item, timepoint, response, .drop = FALSE) %>%
  group_by(item, timepoint) %>%
  mutate(prop = round(n / sum(n), 2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = item, names_from = c(response, timepoint),
              values_from = prop, names_sort = TRUE)
```

**Years of data collection**

Amount of NAs

```{r}
sapply(swls[grepl("^FUYear", names(swls))],
       function(x) c(data = sum(!is.na(x)),
                     NAs = sum(is.na(x)),
                     pctNA = round(mean(is.na(x)) * 100,2)))
```
Range of years

```{r}
sapply(swls[grepl("^FUYear", names(swls))], range, na.rm = TRUE)
```

## Remove objects

```{r}
rm(d0, swls0, swlsINCL)
```

# II. Cross-sectional MI

## 1. One year after TBI

### Pre-analysis

**Included vs excluded**

```{r}
T1_swlsINCL = swls %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.1$"), ~ !is.na(.)), 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, labels = c("excluded", "included")))

rbind(freq = table(T1_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"),
      pct = round(prop.table(table(T1_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"))*100,2))
```

Descriptive statistics

```{r}
table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp | status,
        data = T1_swlsINCL)
```

Differences per variable

```{r}
T1diff = compare_vars(T1_swlsINCL, c("Sex", "Age", "Race", "Mar", "EduYears",
                 "Cause", "GCSTot", "CTComp"), "status")

T1diff %>%
  mutate(across(c(stat, size), \(x) round(x, 4)))
```

**Selected sample**

Create the sub-dataset

```{r}
T1_swls <- swls %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.1$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("SWLS.*\\.1$"))
nrow(T1_swls)
```

Create the model

```{r}
T1_mod = 'Satisfaction =~ SWLSIdeal.1 + SWLSCond.1 + SWLSSAt.1
                        + SWLSImprt.1 + SWLSLiveOver.1'
```

Descriptive statistics 

```{r}
T1desc = table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp,
        data = T1_swls)
```



### 1.1. Configural

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod1 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_mod,
                                data = T1_swls,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "configural")) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod1))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit1 = cfa(T1_mod1,
              data = T1_swls,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit1, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

#### Modified configural

Check parameters which could improve model fit


```{r}
modindices(T1_fit1, sort. = TRUE, maximum.number = 5)
```

The residual covariance between Imprt and LiveOver shows the highest modification index (`SWLSImprt.1	~~	SWLSLiveOver.1`), thus, it is added to the baseline model

```{r}
T1_modB = 'Satisfaction =~ SWLSIdeal.1 + SWLSCond.1 + SWLSSAt.1
                        + SWLSImprt.1 + SWLSLiveOver.1
          SWLSImprt.1	~~	SWLSLiveOver.1'

```

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod1B = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_modB,
                                data = T1_swls,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "configural")) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod1B))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit1B = cfa(T1_mod1B,
              data = T1_swls,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit1B, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit1B, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(T1_fit1, T1_fit1B)
```

### 1.2. Thresholds

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod2 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_modB,
                                data = T1_swls,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = "thresholds")) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod2))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit2 = cfa(T1_mod2,
              data = T1_swls,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit2, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(T1_fit1B, T1_fit2)
```

### 1.3. Loadings

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_mod3 = as.character(measEq.syntax(T1_modB,
                                data = T1_swls,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                group = "Race",
                                group.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings"))) 
#cat(as.character(T1_mod3))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
T1_fit3 = cfa(T1_mod3,
              data = T1_swls,
              ordered = T,
              group = "Race")
#summary(T1_fit3, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(T1_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(T1_fit2, T1_fit3)
```

### Full comparison

Fit indices

```{r}
MI_T1 <- rbind(
  configuralA = fitmeasures(T1_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit),
  configuralB = fitmeasures(T1_fit1B, fit.measures = names_fit),
  threshold  = fitmeasures(T1_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit),
  loading  = fitmeasures(T1_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit))

MI_T1 <- MI_T1 %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%
  .[, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "chisq_df", "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
        "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")]

MI_T1 = round(MI_T1, 3)
colnames(MI_T1) = names_short
```

Differences in fit indices

```{r}
diff_T1 <- rbind(
  conf_conf = fit_diff(T1_fit1, T1_fit1B),
  conf_thres = fit_diff(T1_fit1B, T1_fit2),
  thres_load = fit_diff(T1_fit2, T1_fit3))
```

**All results**

```{r}
T1_results = list(MI = MI_T1,
                  diff = diff_T1)

round(T1_results$MI,3)
print(round(T1_results$diff,4))
```
### Model parameters

Factor loadings (=~)

```{r}
T1_load = standardizedSolution(T1_fit3) %>%
  mutate(group = lavInspect(T1_fit3, "group.label")[group]) %>%
  filter(op == "=~") %>%
  select(group, lhs, op, rhs, est.std, pvalue)
```

**Remove objects**

```{r}
rm(T1_swls, T1_mod, T1_modB, T1_swlsINCL)
rm(T1_mod1, T1_mod1B, T1_mod2, T1_mod3,
   T1_fit1, T1_fit1B, T1_fit2, T1_fit3)
rm(MI_T1, diff_T1)
```

## 3. Five years after TBI

### Pre-analysis

**Included vs excluded**

```{r}
T3_swlsINCL = swls %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.3$"), ~ !is.na(.)), 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, labels = c("excluded", "included")))

rbind(freq = table(T3_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"),
      pct = round(prop.table(table(T3_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"))*100,2))
```

Descriptive statistics

```{r}
table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp | status,
        data = T3_swlsINCL)
```

Differences per variable

```{r}
T3diff = compare_vars(T3_swlsINCL, c("Sex", "Age", "Race", "Mar", "EduYears",
```

# III. Longitudinal MI (full-sample)

## Pre-analysis

**Included vs excluded**

```{r}
long_swlsINCL = swls %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.(1|2|3)$"), ~ !is.na(.)), 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, labels = c("excluded", "included")))

rbind(freq = table(long_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"),
      pct = round(prop.table(table(long_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"))*100,2))
```
Descriptive statistics

```{r}
table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp | status,
        data = long_swlsINCL)
```

Differences per variable

```{r}
longdiff = compare_vars(long_swlsINCL, c("Sex", "Age", "Race", "Mar", "EduYears",
                 "Cause", "GCSTot", "CTComp"), "status")

longdiff %>%
  mutate(across(c(stat, size), \(x) round(x, 4)))
```

**Selected sample**

Create the subsample

```{r}
long_swls <- swls %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("White", "Black", "Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.(1|2|3)$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("SWLS.*\\.(1|2|3)$"))
nrow(long_swls)
```

Create the model

```{r}
long_mod = 'Satisfaction.1 =~ SWLSIdeal.1 + SWLSCond.1 + SWLSSAt.1
                            + SWLSImprt.1 + SWLSLiveOver.1
            Satisfaction.2 =~ SWLSIdeal.2 + SWLSCond.2 + SWLSSAt.2
                            + SWLSImprt.2 + SWLSLiveOver.2
            Satisfaction.3 =~ SWLSIdeal.3 + SWLSCond.3 + SWLSSAt.3
                            + SWLSImprt.3 + SWLSLiveOver.3'
```

Create factor correspondence

```{r}
long_factors = list(Satisfaction = c("Satisfaction.1", "Satisfaction.2",
                                     "Satisfaction.3"))
```

Descriptive statistics 

```{r}
longdesc = table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp,
        data = long_swls)
```

## 1. Configural

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
long_mod1 = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_mod,
                                data = long_swls,     
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                longFacNames = long_factors,
                                long.equal = "configural")) 
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
long_fit1 = cfa(long_mod1,
             data = long_swls,
             ordered = T, std.lv = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(long_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

### Modified configural

Check parameters which could improve model fit


```{r}
modindices(long_fit1, sort. = TRUE, maximum.number = 5)
```
Some residual covariances between Imprt and LiveOver show up with high modification indices. To match the cross-sectional analyses, they're all added to the baseline model.

```{r}
long_modB = 'Satisfaction.1 =~ SWLSIdeal.1 + SWLSCond.1 + SWLSSAt.1
                             + SWLSImprt.1 + SWLSLiveOver.1
                             SWLSImprt.1	~~	SWLSLiveOver.1
             Satisfaction.2 =~ SWLSIdeal.2 + SWLSCond.2 + SWLSSAt.2
                             + SWLSImprt.2 + SWLSLiveOver.2
                             SWLSImprt.2	~~	SWLSLiveOver.2
             Satisfaction.3 =~ SWLSIdeal.3 + SWLSCond.3 + SWLSSAt.3
                             + SWLSImprt.3 + SWLSLiveOver.3
                             SWLSImprt.3	~~	SWLSLiveOver.3'
```

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
long_mod1B = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_modB,
                                data = long_swls,     
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                longFacNames = long_factors,
                                long.equal = "configural")) 
#cat(as.character(long_mod1B))
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
long_fit1B = cfa(long_mod1B,
             data = long_swls,
             ordered = T, std.lv = T)
#summary(long_fit1B, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(long_fit1B, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(long_fit1, long_fit1B)
```

## 2. Thresholds

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
long_mod2 = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_modB,
                                data = long_swls,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",   
                                ID.fac = "std.lv",            
                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016", 
                                longFacNames = long_factors,
                                long.equal = "thresholds")) 
```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}

             data = long_swls,
             ordered = T, std.lv = T)
```

```{r}
fitMeasures(long_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(long_fit1B, long_fit2)
```

## 3. Loadings

Create the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
long_mod3 = as.character(measEq.syntax(long_modB,
                                data = long_swls,         
                                ordered = T,           
                                parameterization = "delta",

```

Fit the model

```{r, message=FALSE}
             data = long_swls,

```

```{r}
fitMeasures(long_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(long_fit2, long_fit3)
```

## Full comparison

Fit indices

```{r}
MI_long <- rbind(
  configuralA = fitmeasures(long_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit),
  configuralB = fitmeasures(long_fit1B, fit.measures = names_fit),
  threshold  = fitmeasures(long_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit),
  loading    = fitmeasures(long_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit))

MI_long <- MI_long %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%

MI_long = round(MI_long, 3)
colnames(MI_long) = names_short
```

Differences in fit indices

```{r}

  conf_conf = fit_diff(long_fit1, long_fit1B),
  conf_thres = fit_diff(long_fit1B, long_fit2),
  thres_load = fit_diff(long_fit2, long_fit3))
```

**All results**

```{r}

                    diff = diff_long)

round(long_results$MI,3)
print(round(long_results$diff,4))
```

## Model parameters

Factor loadings (=~)

```{r}

  filter(op == "=~") %>%
  select(lhs, op, rhs, est.std, pvalue)
```

## Remove objects

```{r, eval=TRUE}
rm(long_swls, long_swlsINCL)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
             ordered = T, std.lv = T)
#summary(B_fit2, fit.measures = T)
```

Check fit measures

```{r}
fitMeasures(B_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit)
```

**Comparison**

```{r}
lavTestLRT(B_fit1, B_fit2)
```

```{r, message=FALSE}

                                parameterization = "delta",

                                ID.cat = "Wu.Estabrook.2016",

                                long.equal = c("thresholds", "loadings"))) 
#cat(as.character(B_mod3))
```

Fit the model

#### Full comparison

Fit indices

```{r}
MI_B <- rbind(
  configuralB = fitmeasures(B_fit1, fit.measures = names_fit),
  threshold  = fitmeasures(B_fit2, fit.measures = names_fit),
  loading  = fitmeasures(B_fit3, fit.measures = names_fit))

MI_B <- MI_B %>%
  cbind(., chisq_df = .[, "chisq.scaled"] / .[, "df.scaled"]) %>%
  .[, c("chisq.scaled", "df.scaled", "chisq_df", "cfi.scaled", "rmsea.scaled",
        "rmsea.ci.lower.scaled", "rmsea.ci.upper.scaled", "srmr")]

MI_B = round(MI_B, 3)
colnames(MI_B) = names_short
```

Differences in fit indices

```{r}
diff_B <- rbind(
  conf_thres = fit_diff(B_fit1, B_fit2),
  thres_load = fit_diff(B_fit2, B_fit3))
```

**All results**

```{r}
B_results = list(MI = MI_B,
                  diff = diff_B)

round(B_results$MI,3)
print(round(B_results$diff,4))
```

#### Remove objects

```{r}
rm(B_swls, B_swlsINCL)
rm(B_mod1, B_mod2, B_mod3,
   B_fit1, B_fit2, B_fit3)
rm(MI_B, diff_B)
```


### 3. Hispanic patients

Create the sub-dataset

```{r}
H_swls <- swls %>%
  filter(Race %in% c("Hispanic Orgin"),
         if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.(1|2|3)$"), ~ !is.na(.)) ) %>%
  select(1:9,
         matches("SWLS.*\\.(1|2|3)$"))
nrow(H_swls)
```

Descriptive statistics 

```{r}
Hdesc = table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp,
        data = H_swls)
```

#### Sample information

**Comparison between included and excluded**

```{r}
H_swlsINCL = swls %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(if_all(matches("SWLS.*\\.(1|2|3)$"), ~ !is.na(.))
                         & Race == "Hispanic Orgin", 1, 0)) %>%
  mutate(status = factor(status, labels = c("excluded", "included")))

rbind(freq = table(H_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"),
      pct = round(prop.table(table(H_swlsINCL$status, useNA="ifany"))*100,2))
```
**Descriptive statistics**

```{r}
table1( ~ Sex + Age + Race + Mar + EduYears +
          Cause + GCSTot + CTComp | status,
        data = H_swlsINCL)
```

**Differences per variable**

```{r}
Hdiff = compare_vars(H_swlsINCL, c("Sex", "Age", "Mar", "EduYears",
                 "Cause", "GCSTot", "CTComp"), "status")

Hdiff %>%
  mutate(across(c(stat, size), \(x) round(x, 4)))
```

## Export results

Descriptive statistics

```{r, eval=FALSE}
writeLines(paste(
    "<h2>Full sample</h2>",
    as.character(longdesc),
    "<h2>White participants</h2>",
    as.character(Wdesc),
    "<h2>Black participants</h2>",
    as.character(Bdesc),
    "<h2>Hispanic participants</h2>",
    as.character(Hdesc)),
  "data/descriptives_LongMI.html")
```

Differences included-excluded

```{r, eval=FALSE}
write_xlsx(list(full = longdiff,
                W = Wdiff,
                B = Bdiff,
                H = Hdiff),
           "data/comparison_Long_IncExc.xlsx")
```

Standardized loadings

```{r, eval=FALSE}
write_xlsx(list(T1 = T1_load,
                T2 = T2_load,
                T3 = T3_load,
                long = long_load),
           "data/loadings.xlsx")
```


Fit indices

```{r, eval=FALSE}
toexcel <- \(x) data.frame(model = rownames(x), x, check.names = FALSE)

write_xlsx(list(
  full_MI   = toexcel(long_results$MI),
  full_diff = toexcel(long_results$diff),
  W_MI   = toexcel(W_results$MI),
  W_diff = toexcel(W_results$diff),
  B_MI   = toexcel(B_results$MI),
  B_diff = toexcel(B_results$diff),
  H_MI   = toexcel(H_results$MI),
  H_diff = toexcel(H_results$diff)),
  "data/results_LongMI.xlsx")

rm(toexcel)
```

**Remove objects**

```{r}
rm(longdesc, Wdesc, Bdesc, Hdesc,
   longdiff, Wdiff, Bdiff, Hdiff)
```
